chart.name: Message processing trend

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart

chart.programText:
A = data('NumberOfMessagesSent', filter=filter('stat', 'sum'), rollup='sum').sum().publish(label='A')
B = data('NumberOfMessagesReceived', filter=filter('stat', 'sum'), rollup='sum').sum().publish(label='B')
C = data('NumberOfMessagesDeleted', filter=filter('stat', 'sum'), rollup='sum').sum().publish(label='C')
